resultText: Added a regression test to src/__tests__/voiceSessionPersistence.test.tsx asserting that resolveVoiceSessionConfig('agent-jarvis', null) returns locale 'en-AU'. Read src/lib/voiceSessionConfig.ts first: the function signature is resolveVoiceSessionConfig(agentId: string, override: string | null, fallbackVoice = 'aura-helios-en'): VoiceSessionConfig, and for 'agent-jarvis' with null override it returns { provider: 'deepgram', model: 'aura-helios-en', voiceId: 'aura-helios-en', locale: 'en-AU', override: null }. The new test was appended inside the existing 'resolveVoiceSessionConfig (pure)' describe block. Ran only that test file with `npx vitest run src/__tests__/voiceSessionPersistence.test.tsx` — exit code 0, all tests passed. No production source or unrelated tests were modified.
